Intro.title: About
Intro.lead: I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with 5 years of experience, currently leading frontend at Datasport Germany. I like to keep things short and to the point — so I'll do the same here.
Intro.drive: What drives me: I like understanding systems end-to-end — not just building what's specified, but digging into requirements with product owners and designers until the details are actually clear.
Intro.scale: I care about building things that scale beyond one feature — design systems, reusable components, code that other engineers can build on without guessing.
Intro.mentoring: I also enjoy mentoring — code review, pairing, helping engineers grow into independent contributors.
Intro.communication: And I value direct communication — I'd rather flag a problem early than let it surface late. Keeps the whole team moving.

uni-donate.title: uni-donate
uni-donate.description: A blockchain donation platform on the Internet Computer — on-chain giving for universities, without the usual payment rails. Built in Svelte after learning it from zero in one week.

privateStorybook.title: Private Storybook
privateStorybook.description: A dark-first design system generated from TypeScript straight into Figma: components, variants, icons, tokens and page templates from one source of truth.

orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.description: A public map with self-intro access: request access, introduce yourself, get approved, download the payload.

omm.title: Omm
omm.description: Internal dashboard behind custom SSO — overview, CRUD over points, and reviewing the intro requests coming in from Orbit.

ai-tooling-security.title: AI Tooling Security
ai-tooling-security.description: Investigating AI-agent tooling and where the holes are — threat-modelling what happens when a compromised agent reaches docker.sock, and prototyping a proxy layer that filters agent output.

ai-resume.title: AI Resume
ai-resume.description: A chat on this site that answers questions about my experience — grounded in my CV and personal notes through retrieval, honest when something isn't there, and replying in whatever language you ask. Swappable LLMs behind one stateless API.

sporTechCompany.summary: Took over the platform after a high-value CRM project had failed. Restructured the team, cut monthly running costs sharply, and kept every key client.
bullets: Rewrote the mission-critical components that had caused the failure, then rebuilt the participant CRM from scratch — a virtualized grid and a form of interdependent fields driven by a custom DSL and validated on the server.
Shipped a multi-step registration platform with SEPA, PayPal, and Payrexx payments for high-profile client launches.
Built an embeddable, themeable registration widget (web components + MUI) adopted by B2B partners, and designed group registration for large-scale events.

Built and owned a private UI kit reused across several products. Built an AI coaching product end to end (Next.js PWA, NestJS). Led sprint demos and refinement, and mentored developers into independent engineers.

addTechCompany.summary: Owned code quality and TDD culture on a media-planning platform.
bullets: Rebuilt the media-plan table — thousands of editable cells, drag-and-drop, resizing, and zoom — into the reference implementation for the micro-frontend migration (Webpack 5).
Built a shared MUI-based UI kit adopted by independent teams across the micro-frontend monorepo.
Turned vague business requests into clear technical specs, and mentored junior engineers into independent contributors.

BeyondCode.title: The part that explains the rest.

music.title: Music, 15 years
music.body: Recorder from age four — learned notes before letters — and trumpet from 11 to 19. Handel, Albinoni, Piazzolla; originals only. Music taught me precision: small details compound into masterpieces, or into bugs.

boxing.title: Boxing
boxing.body: A year and a half of it. Discipline, and staying calm when hit.

books.title: Books
books.body: Tom Sawyer, the Orthodox Bible, and on the reread list: Goethe's Faust, Dante, Gorky's Danko — the man who carried everything alone. Carrying everything solo was my biggest flaw; delegation is the fix.

pattern-matching.title: Pattern-matching
pattern-matching.body: Attentive by nature — I remember key facts and build cause-and-effect chains like a detective. It found the vulnerabilities; it also gets me called paranoid. Both are true costs of the same skill.
